The Webb County Sheriff's Office is asking for the public's help finding a man wanted in connection with a double homicide in the Pueblo Nuevo community, and warns that he should be considered armed and dangerous.

According to the Sheriff's Office, deputies were dispatched at approximately 11:27 p.m. on Friday, October 24, to 808 Main Street in Pueblo Nuevo, about 11 miles east of Laredo off State Highway 359. Deputies found two victims suffering from apparent gunshot wounds and declared a "man down" emergency, performing CPR at the scene. One victim was pronounced deceased at the scene, and the second victim was taken to a local hospital, where they later died from their injuries. The victims have not been publicly identified.

Investigators identified the suspect as Manuel De Jesus Cruz-Estudillo, and two arrest warrants charging him with murder have been issued, the Sheriff's Office said. The Sheriff's wanted poster lists him as Manuel De Jesus Estudillo. He remains at large.

Cruz-Estudillo was last seen driving a black Volkswagen Atlas SUV, according to the Sheriff's Office. The Sheriff's Office notes that the vehicle photograph it published depicts a vehicle similar to the one the suspect was last seen operating, and does not depict the actual suspect vehicle.

Sheriff Martín Cuéllar said the investigation remains active, with the Criminal Investigations Division working alongside the Patrol Division since the initial call, pursuing leads, interviewing witnesses, and canvassing the surrounding area. "He should be considered armed and dangerous, and I urge the public not to approach or confront him," Cuéllar said.

The Sheriff's Office is offering up to a $1,000 cash reward for information leading to the suspect's arrest. Anyone with information about the incident or Cruz-Estudillo's whereabouts is urged to call the Webb County Sheriff's Office at (956) 415-BUST (2878) or Webb County Dispatch at (956) 523-4408. Do not approach or confront the suspect.

The charges against Cruz-Estudillo are allegations, and he is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law. Webb Watch 956 will update this story as verified information becomes available.

Update — October 26, 2026

On Monday, the Webb County Sheriff's Office identified the two men killed in the Friday night shooting in Pueblo Nuevo as Raul Ramos Moreno, 43, and Gustavo Ramos Moreno, 40, at a news conference, according to KGNS and a sheriff's office account of the briefing. Manuel De Jesus Cruz-Estudillo, 39, remains at large, and the two murder warrants issued for his arrest remain outstanding. Officials said they believe Cruz-Estudillo acted alone, do not consider him a risk to the community at large, and said the shooting is not thought to be tied to drugs; no motive has been made public. The investigation has involved state and federal agencies as well as the district attorney's office, and the Sheriff's Office said it is also talking with authorities in Mexico, where Cruz-Estudillo has family, in case he crossed the border. The $1,000 reward and the tip lines remain in effect: (956) 415-BUST (2878) or Webb County Dispatch at (956) 523-4408. The charges against Cruz-Estudillo are allegations, and he is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office, Facebook posts, October 25, 2026; Webb County Sheriff's Office news conference, October 26, 2026 (as reported by KGNS, October 26, 2026); LocalNational, October 26, 2026.

title: BREAKING: Sheriff's Office seeks suspect in Pueblo Nuevo double homicide; public warned he is armed and dangerous
